tone.title: Soldano SLO 100 (6L6) community pack
tone.description:
🅰️2️⃣ ready!
Ladies & gentlemen - the mighty Soldano SLO 100 (6L6)

If you like my work & want to support me, consider grabbing the ✨full✨ Soldano SLO 100 (6L6) NAM pack over here:

👉 https://ko-fi.com/2dornam/shop 🙏

ℹ️ Summary

The pack features the BAD reissue Soldano SLO 100 (6L6 loaded) head captured using a Mesa 4x12 Oversized Straight cabinet loading down the amplifier. 

✅ All profiles calibrated
✅ Real cab (Mesa 4x12 OS straight) used as load (no reactive load)
✅ AMP, PRE & POW profiles for maximum flexibility
✅ DI and MIC-ed up flavors for each AMP and POW profile
✅ STD (A2), STD (A1), REVxSTD and REVyHI architectures
✅ Extended, anti-aliasing signal leveraged during reamping
✅ High-fidelity signal chain used during reamping
✅ Stompbox / OD profiles included

This full pack includes includes:

• 79 x AMP profiles (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig flavors for every knob combination used)
• 65 x PRE profiles
• 25 x POW profiles (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig flavors for every knob combination used)
• 50 x OD pedal profiles

TOTAL: over 2,800 individual NAM files (across all 4 NAM architectures)

✅ Efficiency 

Streamlined for users across platforms (Dimehead, Valeton GP-5 etc), AMP & POW profiles offer 6 flavors:

• DI = raw poweramp <-> cab signal tapped with a DI box, no Microphone 
• SM57 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM57 on the top-left speaker
• SM58 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM58 on the top-right speaker
• BLEND #1: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58) blended
• BLEND #2: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58 @ +3dB) blended
• BLEND #3: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 @ +3dB & SM58) blended

⚙️ Reamp chain details

• RME Fireface UCX II -> Lehle P-SPLIT III -> Soldano SLO 100 -> St.Rock React:IR II (Mesa 4x12 OS Straight load) -> RME Fireface UCX II

• SEND level: 18.995 dBu
• RETURN level: 13.195 dBu

Use the "Calibration" feature (video linked) in the NAM plugin to get the most out of these profiles: 

https://www.neuralampmodeler.com/post/neuralampmodelerplugin-v0-7-12-is-released

🏷️ Naming convention summary

• [AMP] = full head (pre & poweramp)
• [PRE] = preamp section; use a poweramp + IR or tube amp & cab
• [POW] = poweramp only; use a preamp (and IR if using DI)
• [OD] = overdrive pedal
• OVD = Overdrive channel
• NRM = Normal channel
• CLN = Normal channel in CLEAN mode
• CLN = Normal channel in CRUNCH mode
• STD (A2) = new go-to NAM A2 standard architecture
• STD (A1) = old standard quality architecture
• REVxSTD = higher quality architecture (by Rickard Gerthsson)
• REVyHI = highest quality architecture (by Rickard Gerthsson)
• TSMINI = Tube Screamer Mini
• MXRM77 = MXR Custom Badass Modified O.D.
• FORTIN14 = Fortin Fourteen
• DWHAMER = PedalPCB Dwarven Hammer
• DFXKoD = DemonFX King of Drive
• DFXKLON = DemonFX Centaur
• DFXDBOOST = DemonFX Dual Boost, Exotic EP mode
• JR.TheJef = J.Rockett Audio Designs The Jeff Archer
• GRIND = Fortin Grind
• ODD = Warm Audio ODD
• BO$$ = Boss GE-7 Equalizer

📒 Spreadsheet with settings & inspiration for all profiles:

https://mega.nz/file/WkxF1BCI#ocixVn-C88EXRRvKLwo5lidOYlMXAmnmvEIufY7mhXc
